name: ISS International School
summary: IB continuum school near Preston / Alexandra with a long Singapore history.
body: ISS is an established IB school serving a diverse international community near the Alexandra / River Valley west edge. It is a frequent comparison school against larger UK/US campuses for families who want IB with a slightly different scale and culture. Dual-career families should request the learning-support handbook and any tutoring referral norms before assuming classroom strategies equal 1:1 rescue. Dual-career note: keep book-order wallet caps written before fair bundles and signed copies stack.
